audit: A.T.O.M product capability, UX and growth audit
head: d0763974e2b5b68c209fda5c680cdfd8b1bdde2a

friction.title: Map does not move to new results
friction.detail: After Run Sector / Evaluate / Optimize the map stays at city zoom; rays are invisible until the icon-only 'Fit selected cells' is pressed. fitRequestVersion only increments from that button.

friction.title: First result reads as failure with contradictory metrics
friction.detail: Default 28 GHz result: Blocked 99.2%, Average Rx −185.5 dBm, next to a red 'Coverage Gaps' card showing 0 underserved / 0.0% / Unmet demand 0 / Worst Rx 0.0 dBm. 4G default is 84.2% blocked. Nothing explains that 'blocked rays' and 'demand gaps' measure different things.

friction.title: Units rendered as 'DBm' and 'M'
friction.detail: .metric-row strong uses text-transform: capitalize, so '-185.5 dBm' shows as 'DBm' and '400.0 m' as '400.0 M' (reads as mega). Accessibility tree has correct text.

friction.title: Pareto alternatives cannot be adopted after the default optimize path
friction.detail: Optimizing in the working draft (the default) produces runs without scenario_revision_id; Apply solution… opens a dialog whose buttons are disabled with 'not bound to a retained source Version' and no recovery step. The UI never states that the recommended solution is already written into the draft.

friction.title: Candidate recommendations are effectively hidden
friction.detail: Only entry is the 5th Results tab, which becomes 'Solutions' (and hides the recommendation panel) after any Pareto optimization. Prerequisites (2–5 cells AND a drawn area) conflict with area drawing auto-selecting up to 8.

friction.title: Comparison is split and the scenario comparison is unreachable with network results
friction.detail: Results → Compare means 'Baseline vs Recommended' for network results and 'two saved scenarios' otherwise; input diffs live in a collapsed Scenarios disclosure. A network planner cannot reach saved-scenario KPI comparison.

friction.title: Measurement validation filed under Data → Research
friction.detail: CSV measurement validation with an explicit canonical calibration action sits inside a 'Research / reference' disclosure in Review → Data, while Analyze → RF Diagnostics hosts a different campaign-file 'measurement validation'.

friction.title: Results do not survive reload
friction.detail: Reloading a draft shows 'Run needed'; reloading after saving a Version shows 'Ready · UNAVAILABLE · Run unavailable' although the run exists in Run history. Users cannot tell whether work was lost.

friction.title: Mode switch flagged as 'Result out of date' with hash-heavy copy
friction.detail: Switching Single→Network immediately shows STALE and 'Optimization 3ca91dc3…eec14b came from its original input. Run again for this plan.'

friction.title: Area selection silently truncates and says 'towers'
friction.detail: '272 towers found, nearest 8 selected.' does not say nearest to what, which were chosen, or how to change them; selected cells are not fitted into view.

friction.title: Map key collides with drawing and clips at 1440×900
friction.detail: A polygon vertex clicked over the Map key was swallowed (4-point area became a triangle); with interference visible the SINR legend is clipped.

friction.title: Interference completion is a dead end in its own tool
friction.detail: After Analyze Interference the panel looks unchanged; summary lives in Review → Results → Interference; the command-bar CURRENT chip disappears.

friction.title: Downloads are not meaningfully named
friction.detail: Markdown report downloads as '<uuid>.md'; project export is always '<project-slug>.atom-project.json'.

friction.title: Markdown report duplicates content and embeds raw SVG
friction.detail: 'RF Result' and 'RF Propagation Performance' are identical tables; executive summary 'RF result' shows only 'Constraints: Not configured' for a single cell; ~600 lines of inline SVG paths (82 KB) that many Markdown viewers do not render.

friction.title: Report lineage reads as contradictory
friction.detail: Report source said 'No saved Version'; the stored Report then says 'Sector plan 1 · Version 1 · Runs: None' and its source card shows HISTORICAL for a report generated seconds earlier.

friction.title: Save version naming inconsistencies
friction.detail: Accessible name 'Save current' vs visible 'Save version' (label-in-name); 'Save version' vs 'Save Version'; progress says 'Saving scenario…'.

friction.title: Project menu cannot be dismissed with Escape
friction.detail: Menu closes only on outside pointer-down; trigger keeps the label 'Open project menu' while expanded.

friction.title: Connection and server errors are raw
friction.detail: Backend down: 'Failed to fetch' and command bar 'Cell No tower'; 500: 'internal error'. No retry or cause. 429 copy is good ('Try again in about 17 seconds').

friction.title: Invalid input lacks inline error and misdirects
friction.detail: TX power 99 dBm: field shows no error state or aria-invalid; primary becomes disabled 'Resolve setup issues'; map prompt says 'Fix 1 invalid selected cell profile in Inventory' although the value was entered in Setup.

friction.title: Results tab strip overflows at every desktop width
friction.detail: Tablist scrollWidth 403 px vs clientWidth 335 (1440), 321 (1280), 295 (1024); 5th tab label clipped ('C…', 'ptimization').

friction.title: Command-bar text collision at 1280×800
friction.detail: '28.0 GHz' overprints 'RF details' when a CURRENT run chip is present.

friction.title: Scenario naming and Version state wording drift
friction.detail: Auto-name 'Sector plan 1' persists for an 8-cell network; header 'Version 1 Unsaved' while Results says 'Sector plan 1 · No saved Version' for the same state.

friction.title: Run history entries are hashes
friction.detail: 'Optimization · f1a1e6d2…73ba08 · Working draft · No saved Version' with no score, cell count or change summary.

friction.title: Pareto alternatives are a long list without a trade-off view
friction.detail: 25 cards with near-identical values (Demand 28.3% on every card); Experiments already renders a Pareto SVG but network optimization does not.

friction.title: No first-run orientation or sample entry
friction.detail: First screen offers 'Run Sector' with no statement of what it produces; the bundled sample project is reachable only by reading README and importing a file.

friction.title: Optimization lives away from the plan/result loop
friction.detail: Run/Evaluate are in the command bar, but Optimize is Simulate → Propagation and its priorities/constraints are behind 'Advanced analysis'. Results → Optimization empty state must send users to Propagation.

friction.title: Appearance setting hidden in Layers
friction.detail: Light/Dark/System radios are inside the Map layers menu.

friction.title: Feature doc tool count drift
friction.detail: docs/features.md says 'Ten workflow tools'; the rail has 14 tools in 4 stages.

friction.title: Keyboard reach of map planning
friction.detail: Only the active cell marker is focusable; result layers are canvas; no shortcuts. Inventory search is the keyboard alternative but is not signposted.

friction.title: Drawer heading focus ring looks like a text field
friction.detail: Programmatic heading focus on drawer open renders a rectangular outline around 'Setup' that reads as an editable input.

friction.title: Two different controls named 'Select cells'
friction.detail: In Network mode with <2 cells the primary action and the map toolbar mode both expose 'Select cells'.

friction.title: Fit zoom for single-sector results is too wide
friction.detail: After Fit selected cells a 400 m, 99%-blocked 28 GHz result is a few barely visible stubs.

friction.title: 'Tower' wording in Cell workflows
friction.detail: 'No tower selected', 'Select at least 2 towers…', 'Tower GeoJSON could not be loaded', Report 'Export the selected tower…' despite the Cell/site/tower glossary (closed #80).

friction.title: Zero-gap result styled as an alert
friction.detail: Coverage Gaps card uses red alert styling and 'Worst Rx 0.0 dBm' when nothing was returned.
